_note: The fifth card of board 813:4836, on its own page. See
`s1-2f-save-indicator` for why: states 2 and 3 are the same `saved`
branch and therefore the same `save-status-saved` anchor, so putting both
on one page makes the target resolve to two elements and measure.mjs
refuses (correctly). Two pages, five states, five joins — the alternative
was to measure one pill and call the board done.
`savedAt` is `Date.now() - 2min`, so the label really is the board's
'Saved 2m ago' rather than a pinned string: `formatRelativeTime` computes
it, and pinning an epoch would read '2y ago' next year.
This is the ONE state where the board and the component already agreed on
colour before this pass — `--color/ink-muted` on both sides. The board's
caption for this card ('Green dot, grey text') is also the rule the
component applies to saving and unsaved, which is the substance of the
colour disagreement recorded in the sibling recipe.
